presentation.label: IMPROVED MOD ASSIGN
presentation.summary: Link a parameter to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO by holding FIX, SAMPLER or LFO and turning its knob; hold SCENE and turn to lock it in the active scene.
presentation.overview: Hold FIX and turn any knob on a sound page: that parameter is linked to velocity, and the turn sets how much. Hold SAMPLER and turn to link it to aftertouch instead. While either key is held, every linked knob shows its amount the way stock shows a performance or scene lock. It fills stock's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots of the selected sound, so the links save with the kit, show in SOUND SETTINGS as usual and keep playing on a unit without the mod. Hold SCENE and turn a knob: the parameter is locked in the active scene, as scene edit does with the scene's pad held, without leaving the page.
highlights: Velocity, aftertouch or the LFO to any parameter in one gesture
Stays on the page you are playing
Uses stock's slots, saved with the kit
SCENE + knob writes a scene lock from the page
usage: Select a sound track and press FLTR. Hold FIX: FRQ and RES show 0 boxes, the new kit's velocity links.
Keep FIX held and turn FRQ to the right: its box counts up and FRQ itself does not move. Play soft and hard hits: harder ones open the filter.
Press AMP, hold SAMPLER and turn DEC: pad pressure now lengthens the decay.
Hold FIX and press FRQ's knob: the link goes back to 0, and its slot is free for another parameter.
Press FLTR, hold LFO and turn FRQ: the LFO now moves the filter. Keep turning to set the depth, then let go and tap LFO: the LFO page shows DST FRQ.

Press SCENE, BD's pad and SCENE again: scene 1 is active. Hold SCENE: the scene's locks show as boxes. Turn SWT: it becomes a lock in scene 1, and the page stays. Still holding SCENE, press REC to copy the scene.

access.location: The FIX, SAMPLER, LFO and SCENE keys, on a track's pages (FIX and SAMPLER on the sound tracks only) and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Select a sound track and open its SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP or LFO page.
Hold FIX: linked knobs show their velocity amounts. Turn a knob to link it or change its amount.
Hold SAMPLER for aftertouch: the aftertouch amounts.
With a scene active, hold SCENE and turn a knob: that parameter is locked in the scene. Hold SCENE without a knob and let go: scene edit opens, as before.
Turn back to 0 to free the slot. Tap FIX alone to toggle fixed velocity, tap SAMPLER alone to open the recorder, as before.

limitations: Each sound has four velocity and four aftertouch mods; with all four in use a popup says VELOCITY MODS FULL or AFTERTOUCH MODS FULL.
A FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release instead of the press.
While FIX or SAMPLER is held, the TRIG page's knobs, knobs turned with a trig held and FUNC + a knob do nothing.
FUNC + FIX, the FX track and a performance, scene or trig lock edit keep stock's behaviour.
SCENE held and let go with no knob opens scene edit on the release, not while it is held.
SCENE + knob with no scene engaged locks the scene engaged last (scene 1 until one has been since power-on), without engaging it. With all 48 scene locks in use it says SCENE LOCKS FULL.
While SCENE is held after a knob, every knob turn writes a scene lock, in LIVE RECORDING too, and the TRIG page's knobs do nothing.
The first knob event of a SCENE hold ends SCENE's hold as stock does when scene edit opens: any other key held at that moment loses its clean release.
During a FIX, SAMPLER or LFO hold SCENE does nothing, and during a SCENE hold FIX, SAMPLER and LFO do nothing.

load.conditions: Read from the code: it subscribes to ev_key, ev_enc, ev_tick and ev_draw only, never to the audio path. Each UI tick it checks whether FIX, SAMPLER or LFO is held and whether its locker is still set, a few compares; a held key's knob turns walk the sound's four mod slots. ev_draw returns at once unless LFO is held with its own locker set, and then redraws one knob's box. Not measured on a unit.

hardware.summary: On npp1993's Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, 24 and 25 Nov 2026: private development images with this version's source, RAM-booted over the flashed OS, a scratch project open. Modwerk's test rig (keys and knobs over USB, screens read back, with npp1993's go) ran QS02 and QS03: SCENE + knob lock boxes on a sound and the FX track, a knob press clearing, a trig held after the first knob making the trig's lock, FUNC + SCENE (PATTERN), the LFO page in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO as stock; on QS05 SCENE + knob, SCENE + pad + knob and the scene-mode pad without scene edit. npp1993 then tested by hand: QM40 (the package's own image, flashed) opened scene edit on the release; QS07 (held pads counted from events) and QS09 (scene edit locks, boxes 0.2 s in, REC/STOP/PLAY copy, paste, clear) worked as described.
limitations: QS10's last two review fixes (REC/STOP/PLAY wait 0.2 s; a held pad clears when stock's table says up) and this package's own image ran in rytm-emu only, not on a unit.
QM40 (an earlier source of this version) is the only package image that ran on the unit.
Not tested: all 48 scene locks in use, a scene pad or QPER held with SCENE, LIVE RECORDING, a kit save and reload of the new locks, the sound.

tests.summary: 0.4.0: rytm-emu QS00 (stock) against QS02 to QS10 and QM40 to QM46 (scene locks, last engaged scene, pads, scene edit, copy/paste/clear, the LFO page in pad modes) and 31 rig cases; the test rig on the author's unit ran QS02, QS03 and QS05; the author tested QM40, QS07 and QS09 by hand. Earlier: 0.1 and 0.2.0 by hand (save, reload, power cycle), 0.3.x by the rig.

media.caption: Improved Mod Assign
media.alt: FIX plus a knob turn fills the first of four velocity mod slots with +20; SAMPLER plus a knob turn fills the first of four aftertouch slots with +10; LFO plus a knob turn makes SWT the LFO's destination with depth +12. A knob press sets a link to 0, and the links save with the kit.
